from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cash flow data from a single company's 10-Q filing"""
    company: str = Field(description="Company name as reported in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Period covered in YYYY-MM format")
    operating_cash_flow_value: float = Field(description="Operating cash flow amount (signed)")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: str = Field(description="Unit scale for operating cash flow: 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars'")
    operating_cash_flow_line_label: str = Field(description="The line item label as written in the document")
    investing_cash_flow_value: float = Field(description="Investing cash flow amount (signed)")
    investing_cash_flow_unit: str = Field(description="Unit scale for investing cash flow: 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars'")
    investing_cash_flow_line_label: str = Field(description="The line item label as written in the document")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt anchoring the cash flow figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_records: list[CashFlowRecord]
